status: Design fixed before the new development and validation batches; implementation audit precedes validation
registration: Local auditable precommitment, not an external preregistration. The design follows earlier exploratory results.

game.opponent: conv{0,e_1,...,e_m} in its original Euclidean geometry
game.full_target: {0} at every point in the entire realized hull, including interior mixtures
game.phase_one: First round zero context, then one repeated known context. Its required capacity ratio is drawn independently per episode uniformly from [0.02,0.15], with efficiency 1.
game.phase_two: Fresh orthogonal task types every round. Each type has independent efficiency a and required capacity ratio r, and b=a*r. These types have different payoff coefficients.
game.scope: Constructed resource-allocation mechanism model. Statistical inference is conditional on this generator; no representativeness claim about NYC, real attackers, or arbitrary games. Ambient representation sensitivity remains a limitation.

fixed_settings.budget: Original B0(h)=6*h^(3/4), G=24576; unchanged block-safe routine and fresh safe tail
fixed_settings.extra_sample_points: round 1, phase boundary, next round, horizon; fixed independently of outcomes

causality: Every action precedes observation; every method faces the identical exogenous path within its episode and starts at p=0.5. No learner restarts except the single fresh safe tail.

development_seeds.use: Implementation and runtime checks only. No generator, budget, window, endpoint or scenario selection based on development outcomes.

metrics.terminal_delta: abs(sum(u)/T), exact distance to the full strict target
metrics.pre_terminal_delta: abs(sum_{t<=H}(u)/H), H is the fixed environmental phase boundary
metrics.pre_mean_delta: mean_{t<=H} abs(sum_{s<=t}(u)/t), computed on every round
metrics.post_mean_delta: mean_{t>H} abs(sum_{s<=t}(u)/t), full-prefix target distances, not an average conditional on switch
metrics.daily_mismatch: mean abs(u), additional metric; also report separately before and after H
metrics.switch: All episodes retained, including no switch; crossing action remains fast and safe starts next round

inference.unit: Independent complete episode, paired across methods. Rounds are dependent and never treated as independent observations.
inference.primary: Two-sided paired t tests of mean episode-level differences; Holm correction across all three primary contrasts; report unadjusted 95% mean-difference t intervals and Bonferroni 98.3333333333% intervals for the family.
inference.robustness: 9999 whole-episode paired bootstrap draws for primary contrast mean intervals; fixed RNG. No sign-flip exactness claim.
inference.sensitivity: All fixed scenarios and controls reported descriptively with intervals; no additional confirmatory significance claims and no best-cell selection.
inference.curves: Primary scenario mean curves and pointwise 95% whole-episode bootstrap intervals, 2000 draws. These are not simultaneous bands or individual-path ranges.
inference.precision_rationale: n=200 gives approximately 80% power for a standardized paired mean effect about 0.23 under a normal approximation and conservative alpha=0.05/3. This is not a guarantee of power for a practically important absolute effect.

claims: A successful mechanism claim requires prechange benefit and full-horizon benefit over continuing fast-only. Overall advantage over standalone safe is assessed separately and must not be inferred if its comparison fails. No q=4 experiment, minimax exponent estimate, real-world general superiority, or artificial threshold retuning.
